payload.blocks: Both remaining lands of plan 261120-0625-work-data-model (the version-vector footprint line and the p05j fixture fix). S6A is not blocked.
payload.headline: Main checkout diverged from origin; work-data-model lands are blocked until git recover runs

parts.cause: A path land just before the release window committed 8c3c3a611 locally, then was refused with resource-recovery-required before pushing. Running git recover is not in the supervisor's or the lead's grant, so neither can fix it.

options.cost: One command by the owner, about a minute.
options.does: Settles 8c3c3a611 onto origin/main (4570170a5) and pushes it, so main matches origin again.
options.gain: Keeps the lead's progress note; the lead lands both changes right away when told.
options.harm: None expected; the two commits touch different files.
options.label: Run fgos git recover in the main checkout

options.cost: One command plus a few minutes of lead time.
options.does: Throws away the local progress note so main equals origin/main.
options.harm: Loses the plan.md progress note; the lead must rewrite it.
options.label: Drop 8c3c3a611 and reset main to origin

parts.recommendation: Run fgos git recover in the main checkout. After it, tell the supervisor (or wake it) and it will tell the work-data-model lead to land both changes.

scope.allows: One git recover (or reset) of the main checkout's main branch, nothing else.
scope.forbids: Any change to other branches, worktrees or the S6A lane.

parts.what: Local main holds 8c3c3a611 (the lead's progress note in plans/261120-0625-work-data-model/plan.md) that never reached origin, and origin/main has since moved to 4570170a5 (OPC board line). main is ahead 1, behind 1. Every land of the work-data-model lead is refused with land-target-ahead; it tried 6 times and is now idle.
